author: BNOFeed
text:
WHO has declared a public health emergency of international concern for the Ebola outbreak in DR Congo.

This follows confirmation of the 1st case in Kinshasa, the capital city, and a 2nd case in Kampala, the capital of neighboring Uganda.

WHO: Everything points “towards a potentially much larger outbreak than what is currently being detected and reported.”

At least 336 confirmed and suspected cases, including 87 deaths, have been reported so far.

WHO: “Unlike for Ebola-zaire strains, there are currently no approved Bundibugyo virus-specific therapeutics or vaccines. As such, this event is considered extraordinary.”

This outbreak, however, “does not meet the criteria of pandemic emergency,” according to WHO.
